about_the_game:
WAV&MP3 

That day was supposed to be just a normal home visit.

Then you discovered—
the principal actually has a private bar in her house.

And she greeted you wearing… nothing but an apron.

“Welcome home, dear husband.”

…Wait.
What kind of situation is this supposed to be?

At school, she’s the flawless, superhuman principal.
At home, however—

she’s a complete beginner at romance.

Thanks to terrible advice and her family’s misunderstandings, every attempt at making a good impression has gone horribly wrong.
Brilliant, capable, and overflowing with presence—
yet when it comes to love, she’s like someone opening a dating manual for the very first time.

And so, she makes a ridiculous but adorable request:

“Would you… be my boyfriend for a day?”

Not for thrills.
Not as a game.
But to learn—

how to love someone properly.
